description: Dataset related to cold chain logistics sustainability is published by Mendeley Data. The survey records logistics managers' views on sustainability innovation, resilience and performance. Its stated coverage is China; respondents in cold-chain logistics companies. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through listed XLSX resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is CC BY 4.0. Self-reported perceptions are not direct measurements of infrastructure performance. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
